# Li Liu

> Li Liu is a Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science and Engineering at UC Santa Cruz, advised by Prof. Leilani H. Gilpin. Li studies spatial intelligence in multimodal models and the agents built on them: how models perceive space, build an internal map of it, and act when what they see is not enough. Li has interned three times as an Applied Scientist at Amazon and is on the 2027 job market for Research Scientist, Applied Scientist, and ML Engineer roles.

Homepage: https://leolee7.github.io/ · Email: lliu112@ucsc.edu · Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=hLHzhqkAAAAJ · GitHub: https://github.com/LeoLee7 · CV: https://leolee7.github.io/files/Li_Liu_resume.pdf

## Research
- Perceive: vision-language models answer even when an image cannot support an answer; Right This Way (NeurIPS 2024) trains them to say how to move the camera instead.
- Represent: language models read spatial layouts far better than they build them; learning to build layouts improves their spatial reasoning (Learning to Draw ASCII, COLM 2026).
- Act: TouchingSpace, a real-time voice-and-touch agent on Gemini native audio that grounds its answers in a map, built from zero and tested with 14 blind and low-vision adults.

## Projects
- [Directional Guidance for Vision-Language Models](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-right-this-way) (Right This Way, NeurIPS 2024): A new task, directional guidance, with an open 821-sample human-labeled benchmark and a label-free synthetic data pipeline. Fine-tuning raises the accuracy of open VLMs by up to 16 percentage points, and the best fine-tuned model exceeds GPT-4o.
- [Spatial Reasoning in LLMs through Layout Construction](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-ascii) (Learning to Draw ASCII, COLM 2026): Across six LLMs, accuracy in reading ASCII layouts exceeds accuracy in constructing them by 13 to 27 percentage points. Training on construction more than doubles construction accuracy, improves text-only spatial reasoning, and transfers to three external benchmarks.
- [Real-Time Multimodal Agent for Non-Visual Maps](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-touchingspace) (TouchingSpace, Under review, 2026): People explore a place by hand on a laptop trackpad and ask a voice agent open questions about it. Built from zero with a blind co-designer and studied with 14 blind and low-vision adults.
- [Braille and Semantic Annotation for 3D-Printed Maps](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-tactile-annotation) (Tactile Map Annotation, ASSETS 2026 Demo): A web tool that lets a sighted helper add Braille and place labels to a generated 3D-printed tactile map, so each footprint can be identified by touch. Ten blind and low-vision readers compared unlabeled and annotated prints in formative sessions.
- [Human-AI Collaboration with Foundation Models: A Survey](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-hai-survey) (Human-AI Collaboration Survey, ACM TIST 2026): A survey of human-AI collaboration with large foundation models, covering human-guided model development, collaboration patterns, governance, and high-stakes applications.
- [Human-in-the-Loop Pattern Discovery in Unlabeled Conversations](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-pattern-insights) (Pattern Insights Explorer, WWW 2026 Demo, Amazon): A modular framework that pairs wide-lens views of where candidate patterns cluster with sharp-focus checks of whether they are meaningful, for unlabeled data without ground truth.
- [Agent Skills as Typed, Inspectable Data](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-skills-on-board) (Skills on Board, Under review, 2026): A system that turns a free-text SKILL.md into a typed meta file, rendered as a board for people and compiled into a structured skill for agents. On SkillLearnBench, agents use half the output tokens at equal or better task performance. Built during my internship at Amazon.
- [Experiential Search over User Reviews](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-ser) (SER, Amazon internship, 2024): A search system that turns customer reviews into search facets, each linked to the review sentence behind it, for needs catalogs do not record. On recipes it finds 18% more facet matches than keyword search.
- [Multi-View Self-Supervised Pre-Training for 3D Medical Segmentation](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-swinmm) (SwinMM, MICCAI 2023): Masked multi-view pre-training with Swin Transformers for accurate and data-efficient 3D medical image segmentation.
- [Efficient Conformal Prediction with Shrunken Centroids](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-cpsc) (CPSC, IEEE TIM 2022): Conformal prediction with shrunken centroids, which quantifies how reliable each prediction is at lower cost than k-nearest-neighbor conformal prediction.
- [Cross-User sEMG Domain Adaptation](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-taste-xuser) (Cross-User Taste Recognition, IEEE TIM 2022): Domain regularized component analysis and conformal prediction that let taste recognition models trained on one person work on others without new labels.
- [Data Augmentation for Label-Scarce Electronic Noses](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-boost-ai) (Boost AI Power, IEEE Sensors Journal 2021): A systematic comparison of data augmentation strategies for electronic noses with scarce labels, including a new ensemble inductive conformal prediction method.
- [Preventing Catastrophic Overfitting in FGSM Adversarial Training](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-fgsm) (Bag of Tricks for FGSM-AT, arXiv 2022): Simple tricks, such as masking partial pixels, that prevent catastrophic overfitting in single-step FGSM adversarial training.
- [Multi-Scale CNN for EEG Taste Recognition](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-taste-eeg) (EEG-MSRNet, IEEE TIM 2023): A multi-scale fully convolutional network with residual learning that recognizes basic taste sensations from EEG.
- [sEMG-to-Speech Silent Speech Interface](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-silent-speech) (Silent Speech Interface, IEEE TIM 2023): A Mandarin silent speech interface that converts surface EMG from silent speakers into audio, with help from paired EMG and audio of vocal speakers.
- [EEG-EMG Fusion for Taste Recognition](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-taste-bimodal) (Bi-FusionNet, ICASSP 2023): A bimodal network that fuses complementary EEG and EMG features to recognize basic taste sensations.
- [Conformal Risk Triage for COVID-19 from CT](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-trilight) (Tri-Light Warning System, EJR Open 2024): A conformal-prediction warning system that sorts hospitalized COVID-19 patients into high, uncertain, and low risk from CT and clinical data.
- [Taste Intensity Recognition from Facial sEMG](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-taste-intensity) (Taste Intensity from Facial sEMG, Sensors 2021): Quantitative recognition of the intensity of the five primary tastes from facial surface electromyography.
- [Temporal-Spectral Feature Extraction for Electronic Noses](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-herbal-origins) (Herbal Medicine Origins, arXiv 2021): Temporal and spectral feature extraction that lets an electronic nose distinguish the geographic origins of herbal medicines.
- [Light-Responsive Kinetic Pavilion](https://leolee7.github.io/#project-lotus-pavilion) (Lotus Pavilion, Undergraduate design, Zhejiang University): A light-responsive pavilion inspired by West Lake in Hangzhou, built from modular units that open to sunlight like lotus petals.
